text.title: Yasmine and the Animal Shelter
body: Yasmine spends every Saturday morning at a small animal shelter in her neighbourhood.
Last month, she started volunteering there with two classmates.
At first, she was a little afraid of the bigger dogs, but she quickly became more confident.
Every week, the volunteers clean the cages and give fresh water to the animals.
The shelter's manager, Mr Ziani, always thanks them for their hard work.
Yasmine especially enjoys playing with the kittens after finishing her chores.
Last Saturday, a family adopted one of the puppies that Yasmine had cared for.
She felt both happy and a little sad to see it go.
Next year, Yasmine hopes to start a small fundraising project to buy more food for the shelter.
She believes that even small actions can help many animals.

items.statement: Yasmine has been volunteering at the shelter for several years.
proofOptions: Last month, she started volunteering there with two classmates.

items.titleEn: Situation of Integration — Helping Animals in My Neighbourhood
